interpretation_notes: Complete-event statistics require a confirmed maximum and subsequent minimum in the same loading segment.
The first complete event may follow an unresolved initial descent; inspect first_complete_is_first_observed_event.
Unresolved and threshold-only events remain in the event lists but are excluded from complete-event distributions.
Similar peak or minimum values do not merge events at different steps.
Small local extrema may reflect numerical fluctuations; compare both detectors and the saved structures.
A larger first drop or narrowly distributed later drops alone does not establish structural change or a stable structural state.
curve_summary.summary: Threshold: 1; extrema: 9; combined: 9 candidate drops. Segment 1: 9 complete, 0 unresolved; first complete drop 832.275 MPa; 8 subsequent drops, median 18.8793 MPa (range 11.6024 to 20.8459).

detection.definition: chronological union of threshold and peak-to-valley detections matched within the same descent

extrema_detection.adjacent_slope_sign: informational sign of adjacent difference with tolerance_mpa deadband
extrema_detection.definition: positive-to-negative progression slope maximum paired with next negative-to-positive minimum
extrema_detection.extrema_slope_sign: direction between bounded plateau blocks; zero within a block
extrema_detection.flat_definition: consecutive samples coalesced while total signal range <= tolerance_mpa; restart block when range is exceeded
extrema_detection.missing_or_zero_strain: use signal difference sign; numerical slopes are null
extrema_detection.plateau_representative: extreme signal value within bounded plateau block, last sample on ties
extrema_detection.slope_definition: signal difference / absolute actual-strain difference along point order
extrema_detection.tolerance_scope: bounded plateau coalescing; may combine small wiggles inside a band, never hides unbounded cumulative drift
extrema_detection.trailing_descent: reported as incomplete without a confirmed minimum

detection.matching_basis: same segment; threshold drop interval contained in extrema descent interval
